messages:
sanjay: following up on the kv OOM incidents — we promised an eval sprint to prevent the 'cold cache + burst' regressions. quick sync: who picks which tests and what's the minimal acceptance criteria?

lina: i'll own the prompt-suite for regression detection. i'll create a set that mimics multi-turn user sessions with interleaved prefixes and partial token overlaps. name: kv-warmup-suite. target coverage: 80% of observed patterns. due 2025-02-05.

rob: i'll extend the stress harness to run a warmup window then a sudden ramp. will add checks for memory telemetry and explicit KV alloc/free logs. example config i'll land in the PR:
```
profiles:
  - name: warm_then_spike
    warmup_s: 90
    baseline_rps: 20
    spike_rps: 250
    spike_duration_s: 45
```
ETA for PR: 10d. ticket: INF-5041.

tara: infra side: i'll draft a chaos scenario where we evict 2 GPUs from the pool mid-spike + throttle IO on one host. will run the drill in staging first. ticket SRE-760. due 2025-02-12.

ci-bot: Created issue: INF-5041 - "Load pattern: warm_then_spike" assigned to @rob, due 2025-02-15

sanjay: good. also need microbenchmarks that exercise eviction edge-cases and small allocations under contention. rob, can you add a microbench module?

rob: yes. adding a microbench that toggles cache-size and simulates random eviction sequences. ticket INF-5048. due 2025-02-01.

lina: for the prompt set i'll include negative tests that previously caused OOMs (very long prefix + repeated user context). will tag PR with repro snippets.

metrics-bot: Note: nightly-eval job 'staging-kv-canary' scheduled. will run kv-warmup-suite against canary and quantized-model-2x on 02/01/2025.

sanjay: acceptance criteria proposals: (1) nightly canary no regressions over 5 consecutive runs; (2) spike-run mem usage stays within 10% of baseline; (3) chaos drill does not increase error-rate above 0.5%. agree?

tara: agree to criteria 2 & 3. for 1, let's make the window 7 runs to reduce flakiness.

lina: 7 runs SGTM. i'll add deterministic seeds to the prompt suite to reduce nondeterminism.

rob: will add telemetry hooks to record per-request KV hits/misses and a small histogram for allocation peaks.

sanjay: gating: if nightly canary fails the suite 3 times in a row after a deploy, auto-block rollout and create follow-up. can someone file the automation ticket?

ci-bot: Automation request created: CICD-221 - "Block rollout on kv-warmup-suite regressions" -> owner: ci-platform team.

lina: added note: include doc in the post-incident folder with repro steps + sample traces. link to PR and tickets in the doc.

rob: timeline check: loadtest PR + microbench PR by 2025-02-01, prompt-suite by 2025-02-05, chaos runbook by 2025-02-12, nightly gating automation by 2025-02-14.

sanjay: thanks. i'll collate into a short action-tracker doc and link it to the incident page. propose a 20m check-in next Wed 2025-02-04 9:00 PT to validate PRs and run initial staging tests.

tara: i'll run the chaos drill in staging the following week and report back.

lina: will ping when prompt-suite PR is ready.

rob: ping me for telemetry questions.

metrics-bot: Link added to incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1803-kv-oom - nightly job: https://redwood.internal/ci/nightly/staging-kv-canary

sanjay: perfect. checklist i'll update: owners, tickets, due dates, PR links, canary job, gating automation, chaos runbook. please post here when items land and i'll mark them complete. thanks everyone!
